claims.sentence: If you are studying a bachelor’s or master’s program, you qualify for accelerated study under an individual plan if you have secondary vocational, higher, or additional education, and/or you have studied or are studying in one of those programs, and/or you have abilities and/or a development level that allow you to complete the program in a shorter time than the standard University term set according to federal higher education standards
The University makes the final decision on your eligibility

If you are studying an aspirantura program, you qualify if you hold a diploma from a completed aspirantura or adjuncture program, a Candidate of Sciences diploma, a Doctor of Sciences diploma, and/or you are currently studying in another aspirantura program, and/or you have abilities and/or a development level that allow you to complete the program in a shorter time than the standard University term set according to the educational standard
The University makes the final decision on your eligibility

For bachelor’s and master’s programs, the reduction in your study duration is implemented by crediting results from individual disciplines (modules) and/or individual practices that you completed during secondary vocational, higher, or additional education, and/or by increasing your pace of study

For aspirantura programs, the reduction in your study duration is implemented by crediting (in the form of re-examination) fully or partially completed results from individual disciplines (modules), and/or individual practices, and/or individual types of scientific research work, and/or by increasing your pace of study
Increasing your pace of study requires a personal application from you
It is granted only if you have the corresponding abilities and/or development level
The University Director issues an order based on a decision by the University Attestation Commission
The evidence does not specify a fixed number of semesters, months, or percentage by which your degree program will be shortened
It only describes the mechanisms used to achieve the reduction
The evidence does not state how many disciplines, practices, or research tasks can be credited, nor does it define the exact threshold for "corresponding abilities" or "development level"
The evidence does not provide a deadline for submitting your personal application or a timeline for the Attestation Commission's decision
The evidence does not specify what happens if the University denies your request
The evidence does not list the specific federal standards or educational standards referenced for setting the standard University terms
The official regulation takes precedence over any course pages, and any course page details that differ from or go beyond this regulation are overridden
The evidence leaves open how individual courses will implement the credited disciplines or increased pace
